verdict.rationale: Docs show card issuance via API (virtual cards, activation/deactivation, lifecycle management), spend controls (card auth loop for accept/reject at authorization, decline reasons), and adding authorized users with debit cards. However, physical card fulfillment is only implied via a webhook event rather than explicit physical-card issuance docs, and there is no mention of digital wallet (Apple Pay/Google Pay) provisioning. missing for 10: explicit physical card issuance/fulfillment details, digital wallet tokenization/provisioning support, independent corroboration beyond first-party docs.
